'''Hewpaj''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] thief and a member of the [[Blank Look Gang]] during the [[Rise of the Empire era]].

At some point during his time as a member of the gang he and [[Urnon Mossu]] were both chosen to steal a collection of [[Antique Twi'lek pots]] from the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for an anonymous wealthy client of the gang. The pair attempted this by having a [[Gender/Legends|female]] college infiltrate the museum and reprogram one of the [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] that worked there to bring the pots to the museum's loading dock and walk off the edge with them into a waiting speeder, driven by Urnon. Hewpaj's job was to distract the museum staff with his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] from a nearby building until Urnon picked him up after collecting the stolen pots. However during their escape the pair were chased by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] which caused them to crash their stolen [[Speeder/Legends|hot rod]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] into the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]]. Both ended up in the tank of a [[Pierceskimmer]] where they were knocked unconscious and possibly devoured by the beast.

==Behind the scenes==
Hewpaj was a character in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|saga edition]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] mini-adventure [[Art For Art's Sake]] and so the above biography assumes the adventure is completed as suggested in the article.
